text:
nina: fyi - deployment to staging failed during admission checks: runtime rejected new base image due to seccomp profile mismatch + cosign verify error. seeing a lot of small failures.

oliver: oof. can you paste the admission webhook log snippet?

nina: pasted below:
```
AdmissionDenied: seccomp-check failed: profile-hash mismatch (expected: sha256:77aa..., got: sha256:ff33...)
AdmissionDenied: provenance-check failed: cosign verify error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = permission denied for KMS signer
```

tara: sounds like two independent issues: (1) builder produced image with a different seccomp ordering (was the base image rebased?), (2) KMS IAM for cosign SA missing encrypt/sign role. any recent baseimage rebuilds or iam changes?

audit-bot: AuditEvent: BaseImageRebase actor=infra-ci@redwood time=2026-02-11T22:05:42Z ref=baseimage-2026-02-11

audit-bot: AuditEvent: IAMPolicyChange actor=ops-sync@redwood time=2026-02-12T01:12:03Z change=removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner from serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

oliver: that IAM change is our smoking gun. ops-sync runs a policy reconcile at 01:00 UTC daily; looks like it removed the signer role during a key rotation window.

nina: runtime question: when admission sees both seccomp mismatch and cosign permission error, do we block the pod or fall back? We saw pods stuck in Pending.

sre-oncall: admission webhook is configured to fail-closed for security group prod/staging. Pending pods indicate image rejected, no fallback image applied. This is by design for high-trust clusters.

tara: mitigation plan: short term: (A) restore cosign SA signer role so attest verify can proceed and admission will at least surface seccomp-only error; (B) if seccomp profile differs due to baseimage rebase, we can rebuild baseimage with deterministic ordering and re-sign. Longer term: add RBAC drift detection and a preflight to ensure ops-sync won't strip signer role.

oliver: exact gcloud to re-add should be:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/baseimage/cryptoKeys/signer \
  --member="serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
```

ci-bot: Action queued: reapply-iam-binding job/672 started by oliver at 2026-02-12T02:04:10Z

audit-bot: ActionLog: iam_binding_added actor=oliver@redwood target=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/baseimage/cryptoKeys/signer time=2026-02-12T02:05:01Z

oliver: IAM binding restored. cosign verify still failing for one image because it was signed with an old key version that was destroyed. we need to re-sign that artifact.

nina: which image digest?

oliver: gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-02-11-digest sha256:aa11bbcc..   cosign verify error: "public key not found for key version"

images-team: we can re-sign without rebuilding if registry blob intact, but because seccomp profile hash mismatch exists we should also rebuild base with deterministic tar ordering to avoid future digest churn. suggestion: do attest-regen for unaffected images, and rebuild the one with destroyed key.

sre-oncall: do we have a rollback list if things go south?

tara: yes. staging fallback will use base:2026-01-28 pinned tag; we won't touch prod.

images-team: plan: (1) trigger rebuild of baseimage with canonical ordering (builders/PR#621), (2) re-sign rebuilt image using KMS key path ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/baseimage/cryptoKeys/signer via CI pipeline, (3) run seccomp & attest preflight in staging cluster, (4) promote to canary group.

nina: please paste the pipeline sign command we should use.

images-team: in CI use:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/baseimage/cryptoKeys/signer gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-02-12-canary
```

oliver: also adding a short-term alert: if ops-sync removes cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner from cosign SA, auto-open a pager and restore binding. PR: infra/PR#914 to add remediation.

ci-bot: Job builders/rebuild-base/914 completed. new image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-02-12-canary

images-team: signed and pushed. running admission smoke.

audit-bot: AttestEvent: envelope_upload gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-02-12-canary status=uploaded by=builders job=builders/rebuild-base/914 time=2026-02-12T03:15:44Z

ci-bot: AdmissionSmoke: seccomp-check=pass provenance-check=pass canary=5%

sre-oncall: monitoring canary metrics for 30m. no errors so far.

nina: follow-ups for postmortem: (1) add RBAC-drift detection in ops-sync and auto-remediation for cosign SA, (2) CI preflight that verifies KMS bindings before signing steps, (3) enforce deterministic tar ordering in builders and test for layer digest stability, (4) update runbook where admission failure due to cosign KMS perms -> do not relax gate, instead restore RBAC and re-sign.

oliver: created infra/PR#914 (ops-sync auto-heal) and ci/PR#321 (preflight check). images/PR#622 for deterministic tar ordering.

nina: thanks everyone. tagging owners: @oliver infra, @images-team builders, @tara security. closing thread after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
